featured_reviews.name: Het Bavalia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great for old‑season originals at big discounts, but be careful with clothes.

I came from Gujarat tovisit sooper buy in Ghatkopar to buy some shoes, and overall I’d say it’s a good spot if you don’t mind old‑season models and are okay with doing a bit of searching. The collection is kind of mid‑range: most of the shoes are older models, and the majority of brands on display are Puma, mostly in white canvas style. There are a few really good pieces, but you have to look hard to spot them.
The shoes are 100% original for the brands they show, which is a big plus. I bought three pairs — one for my sister and two for myself — and the total came to around ₹5,000, which felt very reasonable for genuine products. If you negotiate well, they can give you around 65–70% discount on the MRP, so it’s worth bargaining and pushing a bit.
The clothes section is a bit mixed — I noticed some first‑copy items mixed in with the originals, so I’m not fully sure about the authenticity of all the apparel. If you’re looking for clothes, I’d suggest checking the quality carefully.
If you’re okay with older models, a self‑serve‑style shopping experience, and don’t mind inspecting items yourself, Superbuy is worth a visit for good deals on original‑brand shoes.
